numinance.kinds.v1.ArchitectureCheck.jso.description: ArchitectureCheck binds a rule to one verifier rule.

config.description: config is passed to the verifier as is; the Engine never reads it.

rule_id.description: rule_id is required: the verifier's id of the rule its findings carry.

verifier.description: verifier is required: the name of the verifier that runs the check.

numinance.kinds.v1.ArchitectureCheck.jso.title: Architecture Check

numinance.kinds.v1.ArchitecturePackSpec..description: ArchitecturePackSpec lists the rules of the pack.

rules.description: rules is required and non-empty; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.ArchitecturePackSpec..title: Architecture Pack Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.ArchitectureRule.json.description: ArchitectureRule is one convention and the check that enforces it.

check.description: check is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

id.description: id is required and unique in the pack.

severity.description: severity is required: the severity of a finding of this rule.
severity.title: Finding Severity

statement.description: statement is required: the convention in plain language. It is untrusted text, delimited and labelled as untrusted when it reaches a prompt.

numinance.kinds.v1.ArchitectureRule.json.title: Architecture Rule
